articles.title: A Super-Surprise: The Movie That's Both a Sequel AND a Reboot!
articles.summary: Imagine a movie that picks up after an old one but also starts fresh with new actors. That's 'Superman Returns,' which turned 20 this weekend. It's a love letter to the 1978 classic, using the same famous music.

articles.title: Moon Water Winners: Students Invent Cool Ways to Drink in Space!
articles.summary: NASA just picked the best student ideas for keeping astronauts hydrated on the Moon. A team from California won $10,000 for their clever Peltier-based water system. These inventions could help future Moon missions!

articles.title: Whoa! Watch China's Space Station Zip Across the Moon!
articles.summary: An astrophotographer caught amazing video of China's Tiangong space station flying in front of the Moon. The station's solar panels are easy to spot as it zooms past a giant crater. You can try to see it too!
